jobs.title: Integration & HyperAutomation Engineer
jobs.description:
Clorox is the place that’s committed to growth – for our people and our brands. Guided by our purpose and values, and with people at the center of everything we do, we believe every one of us can make a positive impact on consumers, communities, and teammates. Join our team. #CloroxIsThePlace

**Your role at Clorox:**

The Integration & HyperAutomation Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, deploying, and supporting enterprise integrations and intelligent automations that enable business process transformation, operational efficiency, and digital innovation. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with expertise in APIs, integrations, robotic process automation (RPA), workflow automation, and AI-enabled automation capabilities. The engineer partners closely with Solution Architects, Product Owners, Technical Leads, Business Analysts, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, and business stakeholders to implement secure, reliable, and reusable solutions that connect applications, data, and business processes across the enterprise.

**In this role, you will:**

This role sits at the centre of Clorox's digital transformation agenda. The Integration & HyperAutomation Engineer helps the business operate faster, smarter, and more efficiently by connecting enterprise systems and automating complex business processes. Through enterprise integrations, APIs, robotic process automation (RPA), and AI-enabled solutions, this position directly contributes to productivity improvements, scalability, and innovation across the organisation.

The successful candidate will design, build, and support enterprise integrations using MuleSoft Anypoint Platform and intelligent automations using UiPath. They will work with business and technology teams to create secure, scalable solutions that connect applications, data, and workflows across functions such as Finance, HR, Sales, Marketing, and Operations.

Key areas of focus include:

* Building and managing APIs and enterprise integrations
* Developing intelligent automation and RPA solutions
* Leveraging AI services to enhance business processes
* Supporting enterprise-wide digital transformation initiatives
* Creating reusable assets and frameworks that accelerate future delivery

Key selling points:

* Opportunity to work on high-impact enterprise transformation initiatives
* Exposure to cutting-edge technologies including Generative AI, Agentic AI, intelligent automation, and API-led architectures
* Ability to influence how business processes are modernised across a global organisation
* Strong cross-functional visibility, partnering with architects, product teams, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and business leaders
* Excellent platform for career growth in integration engineering, automation, and AI-driven technology solutions
* Opportunity to gain or utilise highly sought-after certifications in MuleSoft and UiPath

This role is a key enabler of Clorox's digital transformation strategy, helping the company become more connected, automated, and AI-enabled. By building enterprise integrations and intelligent automations, the engineer reduces manual effort, improves data flow across systems, accelerates business processes, and enables teams to focus on higher-value work.

The successful hire will:

* **Drive operational efficiency** by automating repetitive processes and eliminating manual handoffs.
* **Accelerate business transformation** through API-led connectivity and intelligent workflow orchestration.
* **Improve business agility** by enabling faster integration of new applications, platforms, and technologies.
* **Enhance employee productivity** through automation and AI-powered solutions.
* **Strengthen enterprise scalability** by creating reusable integration and automation assets that can be leveraged across multiple business functions.
* **Support AI adoption** by connecting enterprise systems and data that serve as the foundation for future AI and agentic capabilities.
* **Reduce risk and improve reliability** through secure, governed, and resilient integration architecture.

**What we look for:**

This role would suit an engineer with:

* 3-5+ years of software development, integration, or automation experience
* Hands-on expertise with MuleSoft and/or UiPath
* Strong API development and integration experience
* Experience with cloud and enterprise platforms such as SAP, ServiceNow, Workday, Azure, or Power Platform
* Programming skills in Java, C#, Python, or similar technologies
* A passion for automation, AI, and continuous improvement

**Workplace type:**

#LI-ybrid

**Our values-based culture connects to our purpose and empowers people to be their best, professionally and personally. We serve a diverse consumer base which is why we believe teams that reflect our consumers bring fresh perspectives, drive innovation, and help us stay attuned to the world around us. That’s why we foster an inclusive culture where every person can feel respected, valued, and fully able to participate, and ultimately able to thrive.** **Learn more****.**

**Benefits we offer to help you be well and thrive:**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Competitive compensation
* Generous 401(k) program in the US and similar programs in international
* Health benefits and programs that support both your physical and mental well-being
* Flexible work environment, depending on your role
* Meaningful opportunities to keep learning and growing
* Half-day Fridays, depending on your location

Please apply directly to our job postings and do not submit your resume to any person via text message. Clorox does not conduct text-based interviews and encourages you to be cautious of anyone posing as a Clorox recruiter via unsolicited texts during these uncertain times.

To all recruitment agencies: Clorox (and its brand families) does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Clorox employees, including any members of our leadership team. Clorox is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

jobs.title: Civil Water Engineer
jobs.description:
Vacancy Number: 29266

Category: Engineering - Civil / Structural

Job Type: Full-time

The Generation Engineering Civil and Environment Group within Engineering & Major Projects provides the full range of planning, design, construction, operation & maintenance and management services required for electricity industry infrastructure projects in Ireland and overseas.

A vacancy now exists for a Civil Engineer to work on projects as part of multidisciplinary engineering project teams. The successful candidate will be involved in the delivery of civil engineering services from feasibility through construction stage across a wide range electricity infrastructure projects for ESB. The portfolio of work will include new build projects, remedial works to existing assets and the development of new energy projects in Ireland and abroad. The portfolio will encompass buildings, power stations, electrical infrastructure, and large macro-infrastructure such as dams. This is an exciting opportunity to work in the delivery of many interesting civil and structural projects which ESB have in the delivery of its program to transition to Net Zero Carbon by 2040.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provision of civil, drainage, hydraulic and hydrological technical engineering services in the delivery of project works packages.

* Designing surface water drainage systems for developments in urban and rural settings including the appropriate use of sustainable drainage systems (SUDS).

* Carrying out Flood Risk Assessment and hydrological studies (e.g. Section 50 Applications).

**Key Responsibilities**

* Demonstrate a commitment to safety and quality in all aspects of your role.

* Provide civil, drainage and water engineering technical services and design capability from concept to detailed design to procurement and the delivery of engineering works.

* Manage and co-ordinate all relevant civil, drainage and water engineering and associated disciplines’ activities required to successfully deliver projects to approved scope, budget and programme including the management of civil works contracts.

* Ability to carry out site inspections, arrange surveys, analyse information gathered, and to produce effective drainage designs.

* Coordination with other disciplines, working in a proactive way to deliver high quality projects to the client’s satisfaction.

* Ensuring all planning permission and licensing conditions are complied with and liaison with all relevant statutory authorities and other stakeholders.

**Experience and Qualifications**

**Essential**

* Level 8 Civil Engineer Degree and minimum 7 years relevant experience.

* Developed a strong technical capability, in civil, drainage and water engineering design and competence to deliver civil/structural, drainage and water engineering packages.

* Experience in the use of specialist software in hydrological, hydraulic or drainage modelling.

* Demonstrated a strong capability in assessing, communicating and managing project critical technical risks.

* Demonstrated a record of successfully managing significant projects or aspects of significant projects.

* Demonstrated a strong capability in report writing.

* A ‘can do’ attitude in all dealings with internal and external stakeholders.

* Full driving licence and access to a car.

**Desirable**

* A strong commercial and project management capability.

* Experience of the management of surface and/or ground water contamination will be an advantage.

* A strong ability to identify project work requirements and to initiate necessary work with limited oversight.

* Experience in performing PSDP/PD role on projects.

* Level 9 Engineering Degree or equivalent qualification.

* Chartered status in a recognised professional engineering institution.

**Location**

This position will be based in EMP Dublin or Cork office but travel to project locations is a key requirement of the role.

Smart Working at ESB is designed to make ‘in-person’ time together as purposeful as possible while also enabling the effective use of digital tools and hybrid arrangements to preserve our commitment to flexibility. The successful candidate may work flexibly within the jurisdiction where they have been employed, with attendance at the workplace for in-person collaboration at least two days per week. All Smart Working arrangements are subject to regular review based on the operational requirements of the role, the team, and the business.

**Reporting To**

Hydro Projects Senior Team Leader in Hydro & Climate Resilience, Generation Engineering Civil & Environmental.

**Why Work with Us?**

* Opportunity to lead Ireland’s transition to net zero carbon future

* Career development through mentoring and training

* Corporate Social Responsibility Opportunities

* Sports and Social Clubs

* Networking opportunities

* Credit Union

* Generous Pension

* Access to staff well-being programmes

* Generous parental leave entitlements

* Strong values-based and inclusive culture

* Strong commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion

* Great team environment working to our Core Values: Courageous, Caring, Driven and Trusted

**Salary**

€59,000 - €70,000 per annum

**Closing Date**

19th October 2026

**Interview**

Candidates who are shortlisted for interview will complete a Behavioural Interview based on each of the following Behaviours, which underpin how we work at ESB and are critical to delivering our strategy:

* Accountable and Ethical

* Collaborative

* Growing and Adaptive

* Proactive

* Respectful and Supportive

More information available on Our People Promise

**Notes**

Your application will be held in reserve for 6 months should you be suitable for the role.

The successful candidate will be required to evidence their right to work in the Republic of Ireland / UK prior to commencement of employment.

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Statement**

ESB is committed to being an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all sections of society and ensure that no one is discriminated against on the grounds of race, religion or belief, ethnicity or nationality, disability, age, citizenship, marital status, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation or gender identity, or any other basis as protected by law.

Applicants who anticipate requiring assistance or reasonable accommodations for any part of the application or interview process may contact, in confidence, recruitment@esb.ie.

**About ESB**

Join us in our mission to achieve a net-zero electricity system by 2040. ESB is Ireland’s leading energy utility, with activities spanning electricity generation, transmission and distribution, energy supply, energy services and international consultancy. Operating in Ireland, Northern Ireland and Great Britain, we invest over €1 billion each year to deliver a new energy future based on reliable, affordable zero-carbon electricity.

jobs.title: Summer Student 2027 - Platform Developer
jobs.description:
Location:

Oslo, Norway

Business:

Maritime

Position type:

Full Time

Contract type:

Temporary Staff

Job ID:

7558

  

**Overview**
------------

### **About us**

We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.

As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.

**About Maritime**

  
We help enhance the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of our customers in the global shipping industry, covering all vessel types and mobile offshore units. As a partner to industry, we offer services in testing, certification, training, and technical advisory through the energy value chain. That means we’re continually investing heavily into R&D for new services and solutions while proactively assessing what the industry needs today and tomorrow.

### **About the role**

**Are you ready to kick-start your career as a Summer Student in Maritime Technical Support next summer?**

With 15,000 employees operating in over 100 countries, DNV is a leading expert in risk management and assurance. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.

**DNV Maritime’s AI Centre of Excellence - Smart Use of Data** enable AI in DNV Maritime’s tools and global work processes, strengthening DNV’s leading position in digital innovation.

We are 40+ developers and data scientists developing AI solutions in a professional setup. We are delivering innovation with AI to DNV’s business processes in close collaboration with domain experts and project teams.

You will be part of the AI Platform Engineering team, consisting of 10-15 professional programmers delivering scalable cloud hosting services and data platform to our AI solutions.

**Typical tasks as a summer student in DNV Maritime would be:**

* You will be part of a professional cloud platform team providing AI hosting and data platform for smart use of data
* You will be working on real development project(s) where your contribution is aimed deployed to production by the end of the summer
* You will be part of projects improving or expanding our AI hosting platform and/or data platform
* You will be part of a large, international team
* You will work with and learn from experienced developers, who will help you succeed in your projects
* You will experience highly motivated colleagues and a strong company culture and many social activities

#summerjob

### **What we offer**

**Reasons to work with us:**

* Valuable and real-life experience through our projects
* Meet other young professionals through established networks and informal events
* Opportunity to build a professional network
* Well-equipped exercise centre (Høvik)
* Close access to the sea and surrounding park with possibility for different outdoor activities
* Our **Høvik office** is located in beautiful surroundings by the sea and can offer access to sailboats, kayaks, tennis courts etc. We have more than 30 activity groups for you to join, as well as gym facilities and a kindergarten located on our premises. It is also worth noting that we offer free parking and shuttle buses to and from Skøyen, Lysaker and Sandvika.

DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.

### **About you**

**Who are we looking for?**

* A candidate dedicated to advanced cloud platform programming
* A proactive attitude to engage with others to find good solutions
* Good communication skills in English
Strong programming skills in e.g. typescript (web), dotnet, golang, or python  

**We are primarily seeking 3rd and 4th year students with relevant Bachelor/Master Program specialization in:**

* Computer Science / Information Science
Cybernetics / Robotics  

**Interested? How to apply:**

To be considered for this role, please ensure that you upload your **CV**, **application letter**, and **grade transcripts** in our application system. The CV and application letter must be submitted in **English.** Students without this information will not be considered.

If you choose to apply for more than one role in DNV, please state your preference in your application letter.

**Application deadline:** October 16th 2026 at 23.59 CET. We will evaluate your application after the deadline and thank you for your patience.

Any questions? Please contact **Kristian Ramsrud**, on +47 911 45 172 or **Espen Skaufel**, on espen.skaufel@dnv.com

We are looking forward to reviewing your application!

**Please note:** **if you either decide to withdraw or want to make changes in your application, you will need to submit a whole new application with a new email address. Please have all documents ready before submitting your final application.**

**Projects and case studies**
-----------------------------

Our work helps pioneering companies and covers latest trends, regulations, initiatives to develop solutions to the most complex challenges the maritime industry is facing.

### **Remote surveys**

By using an online or video link to the vessel, our dedicated remote surveyors can support vessels anywhere in the world.

### **Maritime Digital Twin**

The cloud-based digital twin is a virtual image of customers’ assets, maintained through the lifecycle and easily accessible at any time.

### **Maritime Cyber Security**

Cyber security is an important topic for the maritime industries due to rapid digital change that come with new threats and regulatory requirements.

**Benefits**
------------

Please note that some benefits may vary depending on location, business area, and employment terms. Please confirm with your recruiter.

### **Profit Share**

Du blir en del av vår globale overskuddsdelingsordning, som betyr at vi deler suksessen vår som selskap. Når vi gjør det bra, gjør du det også. Dette er en del av vår totale kompensasjon hvert år og avhenger av årsresultatene våre.

### **Personlig utvikling**

Du får mange muligheter til å lære og vokse. Enten det handler om å bygge nettverk, få ressurser til å planlegge og nå dine karrieremål, eller ha frihet til å følge din egen nysgjerrighet – vi sørger for at du kontinuerlig utvikler deg.

### **Formålsdrevet organisasjon**

Du blir en del av et verdensledende selskap med et tydelig formål: å verne liv, verdier og miljø. Du får muligheten til å bidra til å møte globale endringer gjennom arbeidet ditt.

### **Konkurransedyktige betingelser**

Vi legger vekt på balanse mellom jobb og fritid og tilbyr fleksibel arbeidstid og arbeidssted, seks ukers ferie, subsidiert kantine, konkurransedyktig pensjonsordning, forsikringer og en global overskuddsdelingsordning.

### **Støttende kultur**

Vi gir deg muligheter til å bygge relasjoner gjennom sosiale og profesjonelle nettverk. Vårt største fellesskap, CONNECT, arrangerer sosiale sammenkomster og uformelle treff gjennom hele året.

“I have become part of a "family", where I feel truly at ease and everyone is valued for doing their best for the entire community.”

Elena | NB/CMC Surveyor

"From a technical perspective, I’m proud of our innovative projects that delivery solutions aligned with safety and sustainability."

Eduardo | Offshore surveyor

"It feels so meaningful to take an active part of the global energy transition, creating a safe and sustainable future for all."

Ming Oleg | Senior Surveyor

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**
-----------------------------------

At DNV, our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is not only an ethical choice, but also a business decision.

Diversity, fairness, and a sense of belonging are a source of strength for our people, our business, and our customers, and help us to deliver on our purpose, vision, and values.

about DEI

**Working here**
----------------

Since 1864 we’ve been dedicated to safeguarding life, property and the environment. Today we remain at the forefront of new technologies and techniques to help our customers transform for a more sustainable future.

At DNV you can expect to deliver career and industry defining work. You’ll be given the time to build your network, the resources to support your development, and the freedom to satisfy your curiosity and desire to learn.

jobs.title: Desarrollador/a .NET
jobs.description:
**Ubicación:** Preferentemente Madrid o Palma. Se valoran otras ubicaciones dentro de España, con posibilidad de trabajo remoto y visitas puntuales a la sede del cliente.

**Modalidad:** Remoto con visitas puntuales

**Experiencia:** 3 años o más

**Salario maximo:** 30Ks

**Inglés:** B1 deseable, no excluyente

  
  

### **Descripción**

Buscamos un/a **Desarrollador/a .NET** para incorporarse a un squad de desarrollo de VECI, participando en proyectos de evolución y mantenimiento de aplicaciones.

La persona seleccionada trabajará con autonomía y contará con el apoyo de un **Tech Lead de referencia**, participando tanto en el desarrollo de nuevas funcionalidades como en la resolución de incidencias y mejora continua de las aplicaciones.

  
  

### **Responsabilidades**

* Desarrollo de nuevas funcionalidades y mantenimiento evolutivo y correctivo de aplicaciones .NET.
* Diseño, desarrollo y mantenimiento de **APIs REST**.
* Mantenimiento de servicios **SOAP** existentes.
* Desarrollo de la capa de acceso a datos sobre bases de datos relacionales y no relacionales.
* Diagnóstico y resolución de incidencias en entornos productivos.
* Participación en refactorizaciones y actualizaciones de versiones.
* Desarrollo sobre **ASP.NET Core y .NET Framework**.
* Implementación de tests automatizados.
* Aplicación de buenas prácticas y estándares de calidad de código.
* Trabajo con Git y pipelines de integración y despliegue continuo.
  

  

### **Stack técnico mínimo**

Se requiere experiencia **real, reciente y demostrable** en:

* **.NET / C#**
* **ASP.NET Core y .NET Framework**
* Arquitecturas **MVC y Web API**
* Diseño e implementación de **APIs REST**
* Servicios web **SOAP**
* **SQL Server y/o PostgreSQL**
* Bases de datos NoSQL, especialmente **MongoDB**
* **JSON y XML**
* Principios **SOLID**
* **Domain Driven Design (DDD)**
* Testing automatizado
* **Git**
* Integración continua y pipelines **CI/CD**
  

  

### **Requisitos**

* Mínimo **3 años de experiencia** en desarrollo .NET.
* Experiencia práctica y reciente con el stack indicado.
* Capacidad para trabajar con autonomía dentro de un squad.
* Disponibilidad para realizar visitas puntuales a la sede de VECI.
* **Inglés B1:** valorable, pero no imprescindible.
  

  

### **Qué buscamos**

Un perfil **backend .NET** sólido, acostumbrado a trabajar en entornos de desarrollo profesionales y con experiencia tanto en evolución de aplicaciones existentes como en desarrollo de nuevas funcionalidades.

**Importante:** la experiencia demostrable con el stack mínimo indicado es requisito indispensable para la posición.
